report.value: V75's found value derives each line's lower bound from the recommended output current of the element that drives it: 275 Ohm for the pad at 12 mA, 142 Ohm for the SN74LVC244A at 24 mA. For an 8 mA 244 (SN74LV244A, SCLS383R 6.3; 74LV244A Rev. 2 characterised at 8 mA) the bound is 3.4 V / 8 mA = 425 Ohm. At 425 Ohm: RC into 50 pF 21 ns against the 312 ns DShot1200 zero-bit high; connector high level about 3.05 V into the 10 kOhm pull-down; all 8 lines of one part shorted draw 64 mA, within the 70 mA VCC and GND rating; a short to 8.7 V puts (8.7 - 3.6) / 425 = 12.0 mA into a 3.6 V clamp and 61 mW into the resistor. A round 2 resistor of 425 Ohm or more on the 16 PWM lines fits every ranked 244 and also keeps a 5-line short on an SN74LVC244A inside its 100 mA pin rating, which 142 Ohm does not (5 x 23.9 mA = 120 mA). At 142 Ohm only the LVC244A pair qualifies
report.source: V75 (P2 found value); https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/sn74lv244a.pdf SCLS383R 6.1, 6.3, 6.5, read 2026-09-29T05:15:33Z; https://assets.nexperia.com/documents/data-sheet/74LV244A.pdf Rev. 2 Tables 4, 6, read 05:15:34Z; SCAS414AG 5.1 (IO +-50 mA, +-100 mA through VCC or GND as P2 read it)
